body: Engineering check, 14 Nov 2026: verified on an emulator (build 151) against VM 108; part A only. Typing "landmarks" in Search lists LANDMVRKS under Artists (the library's own artist, marked from the library), after the catalogue's "The Landmarks" and "Landmarks". Part B (catalogue typo tolerance, N-23b) is still not built; it is on the P2-12 note.
